name: White Horde
alt: Left wing of the Jochid ulus

predecessors.name: Golden Horde
predecessors.text: the eastern half of the Golden Horde's 1352 shape: the Kazakh steppe, the Syr Darya, Khwarazm and the Siberian margin

successors.name: Golden Horde
successors.text: Orda's ulus, reunited with the Blue Horde's lands by Tokhtamysh

ledger.x: 1363: Orda's ulus is drawn as a state of its own.
1373: Urus Khan of the eastern horde takes Sarai from Mamai's khan.
1380: the White Horde as a separate state ends.

wars.name: Great Troubles (White Horde side)
wars.outcome: The eastern ulus under Urus Khan (to 1377) and then Tokhtamysh (1378) contests the Sarai seat with Mamai's western horde and wins it in early 1380.

wars.name: Tokhtamysh's seizure of the White Horde
wars.outcome: Tokhtamysh, backed by Timur, installs himself at Otrar and Sayram in 1376, is declared khan after Urus's death in 1377, wrests the White Horde in 1378 and is installed at Sighnaq in 1379 after Timur Malik's execution at Qara-Tal; no land changes hands between…

certainty.note: Steppe and desert frontiers drawn approximate; the southern edge on the Syr Darya and in Khwarazm is the least certain.
